purpose: Improve short possessions and missing-ball false stoppages; all six new bridge audit fixtures and old twelve final games stay excluded from experiments.

hypotheses.short: Reduce minimum live duration to .4 s; separately reduce H/A switch cost from 9 to 4.5 while preserving D transition costs and duration.
hypotheses.neural: Use existing temporal D probability rather than equal mixture on missing-ball frames only; no H/A change.
hypotheses.bridge: Subtract one from D log odds inside gaps <=10s with finite interior endpoints [.03,.97] and endpoint D<=.2; do not fill coordinates.
hypotheses.expert: Binary D classifier on period-local, team/slot/reflection-invariant player activity at .4/1s displacement and .5/2/6s context, without ball/features/probability/identity inputs. Fit on all36 original training matches, natural plus fixed blind degradation, missing-ball frames only, sample every10 frames, equal-match weights. Blend D .25/.5 on missing frames only; fixed short-policy combinations.

selection: Only candidates passing gates on both scenarios and both reference reconstructions. Rank by minimum scenario Spell gain, then simplicity. Retain no failed policy in production; preserve failed experiment evidence. No further threshold search based on these results.
limitations: Adaptive development on ten familiar games, not fresh confirmation. Existing six-match and original final scores describe the old frozen model only and cannot be assigned to any changed candidate.
prohibited: six bridge data/predictions/references/results for any candidate comparison
production: Unchanged until a candidate qualifies and all needed invariance, reproduction and official-validator checks pass. No organizer submission.
